text: In the Land of Boop, everyone was lightning fast.
Until the Turtle Lord cursed the land with slowness.
Roosters crow at two P.M. Rice cakes take three months.
One boy. One fist, twice the size of his head.
When the rooster beeps... you BOOP.
Five worlds. Forty gates. One finger.
Meet Tee Boop, Grandma Boop, and the referee: the chicken.
Faster reflex, harder hit. Below one eighty? Critical.
World two: the Night Market. Beware the duck in a chicken suit.
The boss: Big Brother Brand Name. He fakes the beep himself.
